notes.title: First free content update/patch is here.
notes.notes:
The first free content update for Drusilla Dreams is here! The feedback has really helped us to improve the game. What we have here is new music and sound balancing. New story text, bug fixes, and so on!

I even added in something special!

I look forward to making even more free content updates to this game now that it is on Steam. Enjoy!

Patch Notes
1. Grammer fixes 
2. New BG music added
3. Improved sound balancing
4. New story text added
